intro: Chick-fil-A is America's favorite chicken chain, built around one thing done well: the Original Chicken Sandwich, a hand-breaded fillet with two pickles on a buttered bun. Add nuggets, the signature waffle fries, Chick-fil-A Sauce and a Frosted Lemonade, and it's a cult favorite, famous also for being closed on Sundays. Below is the full Chick-fil-A menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: Chick-fil-A's Original Chicken Sandwich is about $5.99, the Deluxe is $7.49 and the Spicy is $6.59. An 8-count of nuggets is $5.95, medium waffle fries are $2.95, and a Frosted Lemonade is $4.95. Note Chick-fil-A is always closed on Sundays.
hot_deal: Chick-fil-A value: the Original Chicken Sandwich is the best-value pick at about $5.99, and the 8-count nuggets ($5.95) with waffle fries ($2.95) make a cheap combo. The Chick-fil-A One app gives points and the occasional free item. Remember: Chick-fil-A is closed every Sunday. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a Chick-fil-A chicken sandwich?
faqs.a: The Original Chicken Sandwich is about $5.99, the Spicy is $6.59, the Deluxe is $7.49 and the Spicy Deluxe is $8.15. The grilled sandwich is about $7.95.
Yes. Every Chick-fil-A is closed on Sundays, a policy the founder set so employees can rest. It is open Monday through Saturday only.
Chick-fil-A Sauce is the chain's signature dip, a blend of honey mustard, barbecue and ranch flavors. It comes free with meals and pairs with nuggets and waffle fries.

faqs.q: How many calories are in Chick-fil-A nuggets?
faqs.a: An 8-count of breaded nuggets is about 260 calories, while the 8-count grilled nuggets are just 130 calories, one of the lightest options on the menu.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Chick-fil-A?
faqs.a: The best known are the Original Chicken Sandwich, the nuggets, the waffle potato fries, the Spicy Chicken Sandwich, and the Frosted Lemonade.
